# GitHub Setup Guide

This repository is the public product portal for Wallstreet Tieling 0.5.0.

Use these values in GitHub repository settings:

- Repository name: `wallstreet-tieling`
- Description: `Open-source enterprise intelligence and risk discovery system. One-click due diligence, evidence graphs, subject profiles, and report-ready findings for public or user-authorized data.`
- Topics:
  - enterprise-intelligence
  - due-diligence
  - risk-discovery
  - osint
  - evidence-graph
  - financial-analysis
  - credit-intelligence
  - kyc
  - kyb
  - aml
  - open-source
  - public-data
  - authorized-data
  - investigation
  - monitoring
  - codex
  - claude-code
  - workbuddy
  - information-equality

Recommended homepage:

`https://dear-ded.github.io/wallstreet-tieling/`

Recommended about text:

`Open-source enterprise intelligence and risk discovery system for public or user-authorized due diligence.`

Notes:

- Do not add token, cookie, PAT, or private browser profile text to the repository.
- Keep the public portal version pinned to `0.5.0` until the next release cycle.
- If you update the portal copy, keep the API, MCP manifest, package metadata, and README in sync.
